chain_v1_defect.bug: scroll dy was measured with a 170px template placed at frame y=594; since the data band starts at y=262 the search could never exceed 594-262=332px. Every true scroll >332px was silently CLIPPED to 332.
chain_v1_defect.symptom: manifest v1 reported 'max step 332px = 3.71 rows, guaranteed overlap 2 rows'. That 332 was the ceiling, not a measurement.
chain_v1_defect.consequence: 4 of 76 seams in chain v1 actually had <0.8 rows of overlap; 3 of them had NEGATIVE overlap (rows genuinely skipped): t1_0115->t1_0119 (-0.52 rows), t1_0119->t2_0005 (-0.37), t2_0039->t2_0045 (-0.70). A 4th, t1_0087->t1_0093, had +0.11 rows (continuous but no name anchor).
chain_v1_defect.fix: measure dy between CONSECUTIVE RAW frames (1s apart, small scroll) with a 90px template at y=674 (range 0..412px), then sum to get absolute scroll positions. Rebuild the chain from those.
chain_v1_defect.residual: one raw pair t2_0042->t2_0043 needed a 55px template to measure: true dy 413px = 4.61 rows, overlap 1.09 rows. Still safe.

continuity_check.method: binarized text mask (L<120); dy between consecutive raw frames; absolute positions by cumulative sum

row_grid.method: detect text-row centres per frame (dark-pixel row profile over name column x264-560), map to absolute y by adding frame scroll position, cluster within 35px
row_grid.note: This is a GEOMETRIC row count and is far more reliable than the old scroll/pitch heuristic (which gave 212). Use 222 as the expected member count.
